title: Acculance
tagline: Sales, inventory and accounting in one system.
summary: Acculance is a point-of-sale, inventory and accounting system for retailers, wholesalers and distributors. Sell at the counter, track stock across warehouses and keep the books up to date from one dashboard. Run it on your own server, or as SaaS for many businesses at once.
imageAlt: The Acculance dashboard with sales, purchases, profit and stock at a glance

features.title: Point of sale
features.description: A fast counter screen with barcode scanning, discounts, taxes and printed or emailed receipts.

features.title: Inventory and warehouses
features.description: Stock levels per warehouse, transfers, adjustments and low-stock alerts.

features.title: Purchases and suppliers
features.description: Purchase orders, supplier balances and returns, all linked to stock.

features.title: Accounting
features.description: Accounts, expenses, payments and balances that update with every sale and purchase.

features.title: Reports
features.description: Sales, profit, stock and tax reports you can filter and export.

features.title: Users and roles
features.description: Give cashiers, managers and accountants exactly the access they need.

benefits: One system instead of separate POS, stock and accounting tools
Stock and books that always match what was sold
Clear daily numbers for owners and managers
Your data on your own server, or hosted as SaaS
for: Businesses with several branches or warehouses
Software resellers who want to offer POS as SaaS

faqs.q: Can we host Acculance on our own server?
faqs.a: Yes. The standard edition runs on your own server, so your data stays with you. A SaaS edition is available if you want to serve many businesses from one installation.

faqs.q: Can you customise it for our business?
faqs.a: Yes. Our team built Acculance, so we can add the workflows, reports and integrations your business needs.

faqs.q: Do you help with setup and training?
faqs.a: Yes. We can install it, move your existing data in and train your team.

title: Dashcode
tagline: The admin dashboard template teams ship with.
summary: Dashcode is a premium admin dashboard template built with Tailwind CSS, available in React, Next.js, Vue, Laravel and plain HTML. Ready dashboards, pages and components for analytics, eCommerce, CRM, projects, banking and chat help teams launch internal tools and SaaS products in days instead of months.
imageAlt: The Dashcode analytics dashboard with revenue, users and traffic charts

features.title: Five versions in one
features.description: React, Next.js, Vue, Laravel and HTML versions, so it fits the stack you already use.

features.title: Ready dashboards
features.description: Analytics, eCommerce, CRM, project, banking and more, ready to connect to your data.

features.title: Components and pages
features.description: Tables, forms, charts, auth screens and app pages built on one design system.

features.title: Themes and dark mode
features.description: Light and dark modes and several colour schemes, easy to match to your brand.

features.title: Responsive
features.description: Every page works on phones, tablets and large screens.

features.title: Next.js with shadcn/ui
features.description: A separate TypeScript edition built on Next.js and shadcn/ui.

benefits: Clean, consistent code your developers can extend
One purchase covers every framework version
Regular updates from the team that built it
for: Agencies delivering admin panels for clients
Developers who want a solid Tailwind base

faqs.a: One purchase includes the HTML, React, Next.js, Vue and Laravel versions.

faqs.q: Can you build our dashboard on Dashcode?
faqs.a: Yes. We built Dashcode, so we can turn it into your finished product, connected to your data and APIs.

title: Banizo
tagline: Run your online store from one place.
summary: Banizo brings orders, products, customers and payments together for growing retailers, so you can sell online and in store without juggling separate tools.
imageAlt: The Banizo store dashboard with orders, revenue and best sellers

features.title: Storefront
features.description: A fast online store that matches your brand.

features.title: Orders and products
features.description: Manage catalogue, stock and orders in one place.

features.title: Customers
features.description: Profiles, order history and repeat-purchase insights.
